full_prompt_en: A square anime illustration is divided into two vertical halves, each holding a close upper-body view of a serious young figure against a dark red ground. On the left, a brown-haired young man turns his body toward the right while looking outward from beneath a long fringe that partly covers one eye. His narrow visible eye, sharply angled nose, and closed mouth make the expression guarded. A dark high-collared uniform with gold edging frames a pale shirt and a small red accent near the chest. The left background is blackened burgundy at the top and more luminous crimson near the lower edge. On the right, a young woman with long straight green hair faces toward the right edge in three-quarter view. Her green-gold eyes are large but calm, and her pale face is divided by a firm shadow under the fringe and along the cheek. She wears a dark garment with gold trim and a lighter center panel, its structured shoulder just visible at the lower right. The central division is a strict vertical line; both heads are nearly equal in scale but turn in different directions. Strands of brown and green hair are rendered as crisp tapering bands, while the background remains smoky and softly blended. Strong light comes from the front-left, creating bright highlights on the green hair and warm planes on the man's cheek, with dark shadow crossing both faces. The rich red ground provides contrast without a specific location or readable text. The overall composition is tense and balanced, using mirrored scale, opposed gazes, and red-green color contrast to suggest a charged relationship.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形动画插图被分成左右两块竖向区域，每一半都在深红底前放着一名神情严肃的年轻人物上半身特写。左侧，一名棕发男子身体朝右转，却从长刘海下向外望，一只眼睛部分被头发遮住。狭长可见眼睛、棱角分明的鼻子和闭合嘴使神情显得戒备。带金色滚边的深色高领制服围住浅色衬衫和胸前一处小红色重音。左侧背景上方是黑化的酒红色，下缘附近是更明亮的深红。右侧，一名长直绿发女子以四分之三侧面朝右边缘。绿金色眼睛硕大却平静，浅色脸被刘海下与面颊旁坚定阴影切开。她穿金色镶边的深色衣服，中央有浅色片，右下方刚好露出结构化肩部。中央分界是一道严格竖线；两颗头几乎等大，却转向不同方向。棕发与绿发被画成清楚收尖的色带，背景保持烟雾般柔和融合。强光从正面偏左照来，在绿发上形成明亮高光，在男子脸颊上留下暖色面，同时让深影横过两张脸。浓红底提供对照，却没有具体地点或可读文字。整体构图紧张而平衡，以相同人物尺度、相反目光和红绿对照暗示有张力的关系。
style_prompt_en: The anime image combines crisp tapered contour bands with bold cel-like shadow planes and a softly smoky background. Dark burgundy and near-black hold the broad field; a saturated cool green and narrow gold trim create strong accents. Highlights on smooth surfaces are sharp and directional, while shadows cut across forms in large decisive shapes. A strict central division and nearly equal masses give graphic balance, and opposed directional flow keeps the frame dynamic. Background transitions remain soft enough to push the sharply drawn foreground forward. The overall effect is elegant, tense, and dramatic, with limited color and precise edge control doing the expressive work.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅动画图像把清楚收尖的轮廓色带、大胆赛璐珞般阴影平面和柔和烟雾状背景结合。深酒红与近黑色占据宽阔色场，饱和冷绿和狭窄金色镶边形成强重音。平顺表面的高光锐利而有方向，阴影以大块果断形状横切体积。严格中央分割和近乎相等的体块带来图形平衡，相反的方向流动又让画面有动态。背景过渡保持足够柔和，把清晰绘出的前景推向观者。整体效果优雅、紧张而富有戏剧性，由受限色彩与精确边缘控制承担表现力。
theme_en: A split image of two serious anime characters against a dark red ground
theme_zh: 深红背景前两名严肃动画人物的对分画面
name: Code Geass
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
